subject: Permissions card with host-resource choosers (WebAir 0.2.0 shape), Authorize re-render
method: src/ui/page.ts bundled with the plugin's esbuild and a fake backend serving the plugin's own test fixtures; mounted in the host's layout (main.content scroller inside a 100vh .shell, display:contents root) with OpenClaw 2026.9.5's control-ui-core stylesheet and the plugin's control-ui.css; headless Chrome driven over CDP; real mouse events for focusing a chooser and pressing Authorize. Positions are getBoundingClientRect().top in CSS px.
note: The scrollTop change on Authorize is Chrome's scroll anchoring compensating for the status banner rendered above; the pressed card itself stays within 1 px, as it did before this change (see agent-browser UI layout notes for M3).
